concept.subject: A sandy country lane coming in from the horizon between hedges and forking in two in the foreground, a wedge of clover and grass between its branches.
concept.composition: An overcast sky fills the top third; bushes line the lane on both sides from a third to three fifths of the height, with lupines on the right; the lane comes in under the cannon and forks a little above half height, its branches running out to the lower left and lower right, and the grass wedge between them fills the bottom middle.
concept.layout: 79 round pegs and 62 bricks. The far edges of both branches are long brick slides that run down toward the walls, and their near edges are one brick chain peaked at the fork, a roof over the grass wedge, with two peaked rows of clover bricks inside it. The inner hedge tops beside the lane are solids that shed balls toward the lane; pegs run through the bushes under them, along the outer hedge tops by the walls, along wisps of cloud and down the lane under the cannon; a long low cloud is a brick slide, and pegs dot the grass at the foot of the wedge.

difficulty.note: Close to the opener: the slides carry balls out along the lane toward the walls, and the roof over the wedge sheds them to both sides; the pegs sheltered under the solid hedge tops are the hard ones.

background.prompt: A photo of a sandy country lane forking in two in the foreground, on an overcast summer day. A pale gray sky fills the top third; bushes and young trees line the lane on both sides from about a third to three fifths of the height, with blue lupines on the right. The lane comes in from the horizon just right of the center at about half the height and forks a little lower: one branch runs out to the lower left, reaching the left edge at about four fifths of the height, the other to the lower right, reaching the right edge at about the same height. A wedge of grass and clover between them fills the bottom middle.

picture.title: Forked dirt road surrounded by greenery under an overcast sky in the countryside.
picture.author: Alexey Chudin
